ranking_note: Written from the description of user-interface:audit on main, which reviews interface code one concern lane at a time over the diff, the whole tree, or every lane before a launch. Most positives exercise the motion lane (the animation in a diff, every animation in the tree, where motion would help or must not go, and why an animation drops frames, with --fix behind a yes); pos-train-08 asks for the launch sweep and pos-validation-05 for a non-motion lane. Near-misses aim at the other user-interface skills: write-animation builds one animation, glossary names an effect, write-css writes or reviews styles, and design shapes a component or CLI output.
